question: Can I customise the mock exam blueprint?
answer: Yes. In Assign Exams, select New Exam and use the Blueprint step to adjust question counts per domain. The default blueprint mirrors the standard domain weighting for the exam you select.

question: What happens to data when a resident's seat is removed?
answer: Their historical performance data is preserved in Reports for 12 months. Active sessions are terminated immediately and they lose login access.

question: Can I add a co-administrator to the dashboard?
answer: Yes — go to Settings › Administrator access and click "+ Add admin". They will receive an email invitation with a link to set up their access.

question: How is the Board Readiness score calculated?
answer: It uses a weighted model combining question bank accuracy, score trajectory over the last 8 weeks, mock exam performance, and question volume against weekly targets. Individual reports include a full breakdown.

question: When are mock exam results released to residents?
answer: You can set this per exam in Assign Exams (Recipients & Settings step): either immediately on completion or held until you manually release them.

question: How do I reassign an existing mock exam to a new cohort?
answer: Go to Assign Exams, select "Reassign existing exam", pick the exam from the list, and proceed to Recipients & Settings to choose the new cohort or individual residents.

question: How do I import questions from my own question bank?
answer: Go to Question Bank and click "Import Questions". Download the CSV template, fill in your questions, and upload. Questions are reviewed and approved by Passmed editorial before appearing.

question: How is the at-risk threshold calculated?
answer: Residents are flagged when their rolling average score across the last 20 completed questions falls below the pass threshold (default 65%). You can adjust this in Settings.
